summary: Microsoft's Chess Titans is the 3D chess game bundled with premium Windows Vista and Windows 7 editions, best archived through those original OS routes rather than a later generic chess app.

entries.title: Chess Titans
entries.definitive_edition: Windows 7 bundled Chess Titans, with OS/build and theme documented

emulation.emulator: Windows Vista/7 VM if hardware capture is unavailable
emulation.notes: Use a legitimate OS install and record virtualization/display settings.

primary.why: Chess Titans was built as a bundled Windows Vista/Windows 7 game, and the archive target is its original 3D board presentation, difficulty options, and OS-era mouse/UI behavior. There is no normal current Microsoft storefront replacement that preserves this exact game.
primary.how_to_play: Use Windows Vista or Windows 7 hardware/VM capture from a legitimate OS install. Record OS edition/build, display scaling, board/piece theme, difficulty, human/CPU setup, move assistance, and whether Windows 8+ compatibility workarounds were used.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if preserving an owned Windows Vista/7 install is impractical.
secondary.why: It can expose the game on later Windows versions, but the bundled Vista/7 environment is the historical target.

all_releases.reason: primary: launch-era OS bundle and exact presentation target.
primary: official bundle route and easier capture baseline than Vista.
secondary: preservation fallback, not the original bundled environment.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The exact game is tied to Windows Vista/7 bundling; later Windows compatibility routes are convenient but not the historical environment.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not substitute Microsoft Solitaire Collection, web chess, or generic Microsoft chess apps; this entry is specifically Chess Titans.
